visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of the Maokong area in Taipei. In the center, a large, modern gondola station structure is visible, surrounded by dense green forests. In the far distance, the iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper rises through the misty clouds against a backdrop of rolling blue mountains. Power lines cut across the foreground, and white text is overlaid on the center. (2) The camera pans to show a yellow spherical lamp post standing next to a bright red wooden mailbox on a balcony. The view beyond the railing reveals a steep mountainside covered in tea bushes. Two people, seen from behind, walk down a winding concrete staircase path that leads into the lush greenery of the mountain slope. (3) The shot transitions to a tracking view along a garden path made of stone pavers set in gravel. Lush tropical plants, including ferns and palm-like trees, line the walkway. To the right, the white-walled building of the cafe is visible, featuring large glass windows that reflect the outdoor scenery and a rustic wooden overhang. (4) Inside the cafe, the environment shifts to a cozy, bookstore-themed interior. Dark wooden shelves are packed with colorful books and magazines. A central glass display counter showcases various cakes and pastries under warm, bright indoor lighting. Patrons are seen moving in the background, browsing the shelves or walking towards seating areas. (5) The camera explores different seating arrangements, showing heavy wooden tables and matching chairs. One shot looks out of a horizontal window where rows of books are displayed on the sill, with a view of a garden outside. Another shot captures a close-up of a bowl of ramen featuring thick slices of pork, green onions, and half a soft-boiled egg, followed by a large shaved ice dessert topped with cream and an orange slice.
